source.title: Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 4 (North Down results, continuing "Sion tops the poll"); Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 8 ("Sion tops the poll: rural elections with 96 pc")
source.publisher: Belfast Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names, labels, votes and majority read on the page image of the Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 4 (North Down paragraph): McNally (Ind.), sitting member, 259; Magee (Ind. Lab.) 186; majority 73.

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. Four divisions were contested; the results printed here are those whose figures were legible. The remaining unopposed returns were not printed in the reports used here. Sitting member held the seat by 73 votes; 57 pc poll.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 4 (council-audit, Nov 2026): the citation now names p. 4, where the North Down results are printed (figures confirmed).
